combinationRules.query: Enumerate the full Cartesian product of queryFactors. Omitted and explicit default values are separate. Literals are actual values; fixture choices need schema-valid synthetic values. Resolve required path values separately.
combinationRules.body: Cross topLevelFactors plus every conditional nested schema branch and its input cases. Validate full request schemas, mutual exclusions, required parent objects and domain constraints before classifying a request. Complex values are representative, not exhaustively enumerated.
combinationRules.common: For each operation cross applicable testProfiles with its relevant input cases. Remove impossible fixture combinations and set the oracle from the route/middleware. Profile factors are test proposals, not accepted enum values.
combinationRules.pairs: Each NDJSON row is [firstOperationKey, secondOperationKey]. Includes repeated endpoints, reverse order and cross-version/service pairs. combinationRules.fieldOracles: expectedForNode evaluates a field's schema node after parsing, under its when conditions. accept does not imply the whole request succeeds. check-schema/runtime and fixture-required need an oracle before execution; formats, trimming, ownership and transport policies are not fully expressed in OpenAPI.
